reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories and writes through setBudget/batchMessages, reading the existing sum-amount sheet cells; the income-only-in-tracking check is repeated inline as every sibling does, since the tree has no helper for it.

duplication.why: Only the one-line is_income/isTrackingBudget skip is repeated, mirroring the siblings; the sign handling is its own small expression rather than a copy.

placement.why: The action sits with the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Action, registration, handler type and tests only.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with the sibling actions; a future change to the income rule still has to be repeated here as in the others.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideBudgetCategories, setBudget and the app.method/mutator/undoable wiring.

disguised_duplication.where: No disguised copy; the repeated income guard is the same visible one-liner as in the siblings.
